verses.title: Close to the Brokenhearted
body: When grief feels heavy and words run dry, you are not walking through the valley unseen.
This passage reminds the weary soul that tenderness and nearness meet us right where our strength gives out.

verses.title: Do Not Be Dismayed
body: Uncertainty often whispers that you have to carry tomorrow's weight with today's exhausted hands.
Lean into the promise of steady upholding strength when the path ahead looks dim.

verses.title: Renewed Day by Day
body: Physical frailty and lingering pain can wear down even the most resilient spirit.
Even when the body feels fragile, quiet inward renewal continues beneath the surface.

verses.title: Light Beyond the Grave
body: Saying goodbye leaves an ache that time alone cannot fully explain.
Here stands an anchor of hope that stretches past sorrow and mortality.
